title: Edition-qualified industry classification
reason:
Provisional Phase 1 concept only. Fresh Phase 2 must decide existing-meaning reuse, equivalence and distinctions. It is not a canonical definition or accepted source mapping.

Phase 2 UNRESOLVED: A physical schema role is retained, but a single broad demand label does not define a reusable common meaning. Distinguish entity, identifier, display name, descriptive value and computed aggregate. A field implementation needs a precise concept and reviewed binding role; source strings and value samples alone do not establish external equivalence. Definition gap: the candidate combines source roles or lacks a sufficiently bounded reusable definition and binding domain. Retain the candidate; do not infer absence from literal query results.
